sloka: तेषां संवदतामेव तमाश्रममुपागमत् ।कर्दमस्तु महातेजा द्विजैः सह महात्मभिः ।। ७.९०.८ ॥
transliteration: teṣāṁ saṁvadatāmeva tamāśramamupāgamat ।kardamastu mahātejā dvijaiḥ saha mahātmabhiḥ ।। 7.90.8 ॥

translations.english: Just as they were conversing, the greatly refulgent Kardama approached that hermitage along with other great-souled brahmins.
